author: CheifDonut
body:
Hey this is my fourth ban appeal i am posting it here because when I email no one answers so onto the actual ban appeal.

I was banned for speed hacks by StormzInvaderz  and I was definitely not hacking. By that time I had been playing avicus for about 8 months and I LOVED avicus, several teammates say me and said I was not hacking two of which teammates I remember were endertrever

and riy. I know this want much of a ban appeal but I swear I wasn't speed hacking and it would really make my day if I could play avicus again
